title: Regional admission-control telemetry and token-admit SLI dashboards
creator: Ava Chen
description: Add fine-grained telemetry and dashboards for the admission-control layer that decides request admission and token-level shedding per-region. The goal is to make admission decisions observable (why a request/token was accepted, queued, or shed), expose token-admit SLIs, and provide drilldowns that correlate admission events with downstream latency and error signals. This will enable SLO-driven tuning, faster incident diagnosis during multi-region failovers, and safer automated shedding policies.
acceptance_criteria: Token-level latency SLI computed from admitted tokens with p50/p95/p99 and histogram heatmaps
Decision attribution panel that breaks down shed reasons (capacity, cold-start, policy) per availability zone and model variant
Alerts for sustained admit_rate < 98% (global) and regional admit_rate < 95% for 5m
Sampling and traces linked from dashboard panels to Nyx tracing for at least 1% of requests and 100% of shed events
Runbook entry created and linked; dashboard reviewed by SRE and Runtime teams
sampling_plan: Enable deterministic sampling for all shed events (100% log + trace) for 6 weeks
Adaptive 1% end-to-end traces for admitted requests, ramping to 5% for suspect regions
Preserve token-level histograms for 24h retention with aggregated rollups to 7d
Use hashed-customer sampling to ensure enterprise tenants are represented
dashboards: Overview: Global admit/shed time-series with per-region stack and traffic-weighted rollup
Decision Attribution: pie/stacked bar of reject_reason by region and model-variant
Token SLI Panel: p50/p95/p99 token_admit_latency per region, with small-multiples per model-size
Queue & Backlog: queue_time_ms, active_queues, avg_batch_size correlated with admit_rate
Correlations: scatterplot of shed_rate vs downstream p99 latency and error-rate by region
Incident Drilldown: top sheding gateways, recent traces, and linked PRs/incidents
alerts: Regional: region_admit_rate < 0.95 for 5m => page on-call SRE
Token-SLI: token_admit_p99 increase > 2x baseline for 15m => create P0 investigation ticket
Shed surge: admission.control.shed_total spikes 5x baseline in 3m => trigger automated throttle rollback
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (week 1-2): Instrument metrics, enable shed event logging in staging, create draft dashboard
Phase 2 (week 3): Pilot in eu-west-1 with 10% traffic, validate sampling and dashboard panels
Phase 3 (week 4): Expand to NA/asia with automated alerts enabled in read-only mode
Phase 4 (week 5): Enable runbook and paging rules, adjust thresholds after 48h of production data
risks: High-cardinality labels (customer/model) can explode metrics cost if not rolled up
Tracing every event will increase storage—need retention and sampling controls
False positives on alerts during rollout if baseline not well-estimated
Instrumentation gaps in older private deployments may limit per-tenant visibility
